question: How does abstaining from food by day affect death associated with aging?
premises: Non-eating by day is specified as a condition
Death associated with age is named
The practitioner will go to or overcome that death
inference: Through abstaining from food by day, one will overcome death associated with aging
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean approaching death or transcending it; context suggests overcoming
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death due to aging.
